name: Sixteen-State Spectral Maximum Class
definition: On coordinates $0,\ldots,4$, in low-bit integer encoding take $C_\ast=\{1,3,7,14,15,16,17,19,23,24,25,27,28,29,30,31\}$.
properties: It is union closed and maximum of VC dimension two, with graph sources $1,14,16$. It is convex-realizable but has no strict term-dominance certificate. Exactly, $\delta_{\mathrm{sp}}(C_\ast)=1/\sqrt2$ and $\tau(C_\ast)=2^{-1/4}$.
